messages:
harry: noticed a regression in the canary for compact-kernel-v3 on small requests. p50 +9%, p99 tail worse. looks like host-side I/O and header handling rather than GPU time

nina: can you share the profile snippets?

harry: top stacks from perf (collapsed):
``
host::ingress::http2_decode_headers -> hpack::inflate -> tokenization::emit -> grpc::writev -> epoll_wait
host::ingress::parse_request -> kvcache::lookup -> kvcache::miss -> syscall:read
``
writev and hpack inflate ticks up ~2.5x, smallwrite_count metric doubled for 8-32 token bench

sam: interesting. compact-kernel-v3 added a metadata header field for kv-prefetch flags right? could be interacting with HPACK (more dynamic headers -> more CPU in header decode)

harry: yes, selector added x-rw-kv-hint header with short-lived hint. its tiny, but HPACK state ended up producing more dynamic encodings across frames, so decode cost increases and upstream proxy ends up issuing extra frames

perf-bot: perf-run: build=canary-ks-v3-2024-05-03, bench=mini-http2-ingress, samples=800, p50=52ms(+9%), p99=312ms(+32%)

nina: any differences between http2 gateway and native gRPC path?

harry: gRPC path uses multiple small frames (grpc framed payloads + headers), http gateway (http/1.1) tends to pack into single writes so impact smaller. we see more regression on grpc over http2

sam: two mitigation paths: 1) remove the extra header or inline the hint into existing metadata blob (no new hpack entry), 2) coalesce at proxy side (buffer small frames for ~150us), 3) adjust tokenization to emit slightly larger first chunk so HPACK stabilizes

nina: we also saw increased kvcache misses in the same runs. maybe the selector changed where we look up keys (seq bucket remap). kvcache miss -> sync read -> extra small writes again

harry: correct. selector changed lookup order for seq<=32 causing more cross-shard accesses. combined with the header churn it's a double-hit

ops-bot: canary status: ks-canary-v3 deployed 4 pods in us-west1, alerts: none, error-rate stable

sam: low-risk quick fix: disable x-rw-kv-hint header emission in the host for now and re-run perf. we should also enable rust-proxy coalescer for grpc-only path as an interim

perf-bot: quick AB test queued: disable-header vs baseline, coalescer on/off, will post results in ~2h

nina: long-term, we should: ensure selector only touches kvcache shard maps under a feature flag, add HPACK telemetry (per-header decode ns), and add a smallwrite counter broken down by conn_type (grpc/http2/http1)

harry: filed INF-3498: revert-header-v3 + HPACK telemetry. link: https://redwood/issue/INF-3498

sam: action items:
- harry: disable header emission in canary and attach perf artifact (INF-3498)
- nina: add hpack decode timer metric + smallwrite_by_conn telemetry
- sam: enable grpc coalescer behind feature flag for canary A/B
- perf-bot: run AB and report p50/p99 and smallwrite_count delta

harry: FYI I experimented locally with coalescer 150us window + threshold 2 frames: p50 improved ~8%, p99 improved ~12%, CPU +0.3%. will push a prototype PR

ops-bot: reminder: if production customers see increased latency from canary, escalate to #incidents immediately

nina: thanks team, let's wait for perf-bot and then decide whether to rollback or keep canary gated until selector hints are fixed
